Lewis Hamilton won the most races at Bahrain International Circuit between 2000 and 2025, with 5 wins: 2014, 2015, 2019, 2020 and 2021.

The next most wins were Sebastian Vettel with 4 (2012, 2013, 2017, 2018) and Fernando Alonso with 3 (2005, 2006, 2010). The 2020 Sakhir Grand Prix, won by Sergio Pérez, is listed under the same circuit but doesn't change the ranking.

ANSWER: Lewis Hamilton
